text_blocks.snippet: Crohn's disease treatment focuses on reducing inflammation, managing symptoms, and preventing complications. Treatments include medications to control inflammation and immune response, bowel rest, and in some cases, surgery. The specific approach is tailored to the individual's disease severity and overall health.
snippet_highlighted_words: medications to control inflammation and immune response, bowel rest, and in some cases, surgery

list.snippet: Anti-inflammatory drugs: Medications like aminosalicylates (sulfasalazine, mesalamine) and corticosteroids (prednisone, budesonide) help reduce inflammation.
Immunomodulators: These medications (azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, methotrexate) modulate the immune system to reduce inflammation.
